subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: Should the incident response fix the worker/queue and add staff recovery, temporarily disable staging in production, or expose a publisher-controlled bypass for staged prepublication checks?
rationale: The user-visible outage is real, but bypassing TruffleHog/ClawScan changes the upload trust boundary and the actual production failure requires private operational evidence.

options.title: Repair worker plus guarded recovery
options.body: Inspect production publishAttempts and worker logs, retry or drain stuck attempts, and add a staff-only recovery/status path that preserves prepublication checks for normal publishers.

options.title: Temporary production toggle
options.body: Disable staged prepublication only as an incident mitigation, republish or drain the affected attempts, then re-enable the gate with follow-up validation.

options.title: Public emergency bypass
options.body: Expose a publisher opt-out only if maintainers explicitly accept the security tradeoff and add narrow authorization, audit logging, and abuse monitoring.

recommendation.title: Repair worker plus guarded recovery
recommendation.body: Inspect production publishAttempts and worker logs, retry or drain stuck attempts, and add a staff-only recovery/status path that preserves prepublication checks for normal publishers.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen authored the staged prepublication and worker path and is the strongest current history owner for the security-boundary decision.
